interview.familyPedigree.buildComplete: All tasks are complete. You can now finalize your family pedigree.
interview.familyPedigree.finalized: Your family pedigree has been finalized.
interview.interfaces.mapUnavailableDescr: This can happen if your browser or device does not support the features the map requires (for example, WebGL). Try a different browser or device, or contact the study organizer. You may be able to continue your interview by selecting the next arrow.
interview.runtime.finishFailed: The interview could not be finished. Please try again. If the problem continues, contact the study organizer.
interview.runtime.offlineTaskDescription: You appear to be offline, and this task could not be displayed. Some tasks (such as maps) need a connection. Check your connection and refresh the page. You may be able to continue by selecting the next arrow. If the problem persists once you are back online, please contact the study organizer and provide the debug information below.
interview.runtime.taskErrorDescription: There was an error with the interview software, and this task could not be displayed. Try refreshing the page. If the problem persists, please contact the study organizer and provide the debug information below. You may be able to continue your interview by clicking the next button.
